_owner: fix/the-rail-asks-the-server-once. Phase 6 of the ticker programme. The bar ran FIVE queries every thirty seconds per seated player to render one line, and the operational sweep of them matched 1,322 rows for a real three-club member and took the eighty most recently updated_at - a column with no trigger maintaining it - from which the browser filtered the two or three that could actually speak. Three sources sharing one budget of eighty, ordered by a proxy for recency that is not reliably recency: the same defect as #4601 where a major was crowded off the rail by turbos, except silent, because a bar with nothing on it looks exactly like a bar with nothing to say. Applied to kuklfnapbkmacvwxktbh on 2026-09-14 as 20260914102703 (ledger version 20260914110623): fn_get_ticker_feed(jsonb, integer, uuid) returns all six source arrays in one round trip with a row budget PER source, derives the club scope from auth.uid() INSIDE the function so no membership list travels in either direction, resolves is_registered server-side (which removes a 200-row tournament_players read per poll) and attaches foreign_club_name only when the event is somewhere other than the club whose rail is painted. Registration closing went from 1,028 candidates to 2 via a provable superset, argued in the migration header, because lateRegEndMs parses the blind structure and must stay in the language that has its tests. STABLE and read-only; no new table or column.
